d: The excitement of a wedding begins long before the ceremony, with dress preparations, wedding planning and plenty of drama along the way. From extravagant bridal gowns and unique wedding traditions to family celebrations and unexpected moments, these Gypsy weddings are full of surprises. Watch My Big Fat American Gypsy Wedding Season 1 Episodes 2, 3, 1, 5, 8, 7, 4 and 6 only on discovery+ India.
